RELAY_PATH_TOKEN.description: Your new relay password. Have your password manager make one with 40 letters and numbers (no symbols), and save it there. You'll type it on your relay's setup page.

RESPONDER_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Your Grok Bot webhook URL. In the Grok Bot app, open your bot, then Details, then the routine that runs 'When a webhook fires', and scroll to the Webhook section. Copy the 'POST to' value. No such routine? Ask your bot to create one (see the README).

RESPONDER_AUTH_HEADER.description: Your Grok Bot key, from the same Webhook section (the 'key' row). Paste it as is.

DEDUPE.description: Remembers which messages were already sent to your bot, so none is sent twice. Keep the suggested name.

DELIVERY.description: Holds messages until your bot accepts them, and retries if it is down. Keep the suggested name.
